name: spotter-build
//: The existing web build stays in build.mjs. Capacitor packages and the pinned Supabase SDK are bundled only by ios:assets. Stripe remains available for Deno node_modules resolution.

scripts.ios:sync: npm run ios:assets && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:check: node tools/ios/check.mjs && node tools/ios/keyboard-check.mjs && node tools/ios/stream-check.mjs && node tools/ios/share-check.mjs && node tools/ios/sheet-check.mjs && node tools/ios/google-auth-check.mjs && node tools/ios/apple-auth-check.mjs && node tools/ios/session-storage-check.mjs && node tools/ios/live-state-check.mjs && node tools/ios/watch-check.mjs
scripts.parity:check: npm run ios:assets && node tools/parity-check.mjs && npm run ios:check
scripts.android:sync: npm run ios:assets && cap sync android
